# Feature: Player movement and collision

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Let the player move around a level one tile at a time. Movement is the first mechanic built on the deterministic core, so its sessions become the first replayable evidence.

## User Story

**As a** player
**I want** to move Jolly with WASD or arrow keys
**So that** I can explore the level and reach keys, orbs and the gate.

## High-Level Use Case

Player presses a direction key; Jolly moves one tile if the target is walkable floor, otherwise stays. The sprite follows the state position.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given floor ahead, when the player presses a direction, then Jolly moves one tile.
- Given a wall, lock or gate ahead, when the player presses toward it, then Jolly does not move.

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Only floor is walkable in this feature; keys/orbs/gate behaviour arrives in later features.
- Movement is one tile per keypress, recorded as a timestamped input.

## UI / Feedback

- Player sprite renders at the state position after each step.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Sprites: jolly.png on floor_default.png.
- Level JSON: a Test Level empty room.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Empty-room Test Level loads with Jolly placed.
- [ ] One tile per keypress on floor only.
- [ ] Walls block movement.
- [ ] Sprite matches state position.
- [ ] Recorded session replays to the same end state.

## Out of Scope

- Picking up keys/orbs, opening locks/gates (later features).

## Open Questions

- None.

## Testing

Needs a mechanics playground: new — an empty-room Test Level (movement-room). Verification should record play sessions for replay.
